== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Navigator]] fleet is a collection of specialized vessels belonging to the Navigators' [[Guild]], essential for any maritime activity involving or traversing the [[Aion Sea]]. Because these ships can navigate deep waters where others cannot, passage on a [[Navigator vessel]] is considered a highly valuable commodity, often used as a form of currency or high-quality favor among various [[Guilds]]. While most [[Navigator ships]] are relatively small, requiring only a minimal crew and a [[Soulbound]] captain, they are unique [[Awakened objects]] with highly unusual designs; examples include vessels shaped like [[giant]] conch shells, ships featuring blue fins, or those constructed from crab carapaces. The fleet is a significant military and logistical force, capable of forming massive armadas that have not been seen since the [[Elder War]]. Notable vessels include [[The Eternal]], which belongs to the Blackwatch Guild Head{{!}}Guild Head, and [[The Testament]]. Some factions, such as the [[Consultants]], utilize their own specialized [[Navigator]]-class ships, like [[Bastion's Shadow]], which is constructed from black wood and features a large eye atop its mast. The Navigators themselves are an organized group capable of holding territory, such as the [[Imperial]] Palace, and participating in large-[[scale]] maneuvers to project power or transport massive numbers of [[Guild]] members during times of conflict.}}
